scope: The unit's current Android boot image, captured read-only and adopted as the recovery image for returning from mainline experiments.

capture.method: adb exec-out dd if=/dev/block/sdc48, streamed to the host; no device-side file and no write to any partition
capture.truncation_note: toybox dd writes its record summary to stdout, so the stream was cut to the exact partition size before hashing

identity_check.image_kernel_version: Linux version 4.19.325N-cip127-st11hzyry2046-g96ee6e0e2bfb-dirty (hzyry2046@origin) #1 SMP PREEMPT Tue Jul 21 14:44:19 UTC 2026
identity_check.device_proc_version: identical string read from /proc/version while Android was running
identity_check.conclusion: the captured partition is the image the unit is actually booting, not a stale copy

storage.reason: a 32 MiB vendor binary does not belong in the kernel tree; the hash above is the reference

supersedes.note: the older image stays in place because build.py uses it as the boot-image packing base; only the recovery role moves to the current image

pack_compatibility.checks: header_version 2, page 2048, no second stage, no recovery DTBO, header_size 1660, no AVB footer
pack_compatibility.note: it would also satisfy pack.py's base requirements, but the packing base was deliberately not changed here

usage: watchdog reset to reach fastboot when a flash is required
